card.name: Small linking words mid-sentence in labels
card.fires_on: Small connecting words such as a, for, undergoing, considered and otherwise in the middle of label sentences, where the next word starts a noun phrase or a clause about treatment or testing.

modes.label: Article or preposition before a noun
modes.description: The words a or for come just before a term like screening tool or tests.

modes.label: Undergoing in coinfection warnings
modes.description: The word undergoing in the repeated hepatitis B reactivation warning for hepatitis C antivirals.
modes.example: with ledipasvir and sofosbuvir. HBV reactivation has been reported in HCV/HBV coinfected patients who were<< undergoing>> or had completed treatment with HCV direct

modes.label: Verb or adverb in a conditional phrase
modes.description: Words like considered or otherwise inside a hedged statement.
